reason: The first order is cash on delivery, so I'd try one small batch of phone accessories that aren't in Shorja yet and see if they sell in my shop. I lose nothing if it never shows up.
objection: 21,000 in fees on 1 kg eats my margin. For things I can already get in Shorja or Karrada today it isn't worth it, and waiting 2 to 3 weeks means a trend can be over before my stock lands.
would_change_my_mind: A lower per-kilo rate for traders ordering in bulk, or a TikTok unboxing showing an order arriving complete and on time, would get me ordering every week.
